limits: One prototype room and one original option, not a complete port, checked prototype installer, retail backend or campaign/fidelity acceptance.

No-death is not no-damage: actual damage occurs, then the original same-flag positive-health branch refills it. The separate nonpositive-health clamp was not exercised while ON.
No matched-view or PS2 image-parity claim: combat poses and final death screen differ. Unchanged original PNGs, no crop, resize, normalization or generated illustration.
